title: PC Jeweller hits 52-week high on bulk deal

timeline.title: PC Jeweller gains on debt-free Q2 update
timeline.line: Up about 3.5% to ₹13.6 after Q2 revenue grew 28% YoY
more: Says it is debt-free and has completed a ₹500 cr fundraise

timeline.title: PC Jeweller hits 52-week high on bulk deal
timeline.line: The shares rose as much as 14% after Halwasia bought 5.10 crore shares at ₹14.43
more: Intraday high ₹16.45 vs ₹15.06 open on NSE
Bulk purchase of 5.10 crore shares at ₹14.43 on Thursday
Jewellery stocks led the sector board at noon, per ScanX
